targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
I did not deviate from the provided materials, with one minor exception: in the preregistration, sample sizes
for the reproduction criteria were rounded up. In the transparency trail and final analysis, these sample sizes
were rounded according to conventional criteria. This had no bearing on the analyses or the conclusions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: All six claims were reproduced using the original data; only numerical reproduction and qualitative recreation of original figures were evaluated, without alternative specifications.
